Samir: quick async standup — model onboarding + evals + prompt sets
Samir: Yesterday: finished adapter conversion for bloom-3b, pushed docker image, started smoke runs.
Samir: Blockers: noticing occasional 5-7s tails on long prompts when kv-cache is warm; suspect kernel choice on p4d. @Lina can you share any perf traces?
Lina: looking now, saw an upsample in gpu_util at token 1024, will attach trace in PR comments. :eyes:
Anya: Yesterday: ran eval sweep for prompt set 'support_bot_v2' across 3 model variants. Preliminary quality: small drop in accuracy for edge cases (user-followup prompts).
Anya: Blockers: need canonicalized reference responses for ~12 prompts; current eval script chokes on multiline refs. I can PR a fix later today.
Mike: Yesterday: code review for adapters PR, left a couple of nits around checkpoint naming.
Mike: Today: will dogfood the dedicated-serving fallback policy tests.
Samir: Quick ask: if someone can review the eval CI fix (it's small), tag @Mike otherwise I'll merge after 6pm PST.
Lina: FYI deploy-bot reported flaky tests on quantization-e2e previously — PR #412 flaky on p4d.
deploy-bot: CI failed on quantization-e2e (retrying)
deploy-bot: CI passed for PR #412 :white_check_mark:
Anya: For prompt sets: adding explicit instruction to avoid implied context in some cases, example below:
Anya: ```
PROMPT: "You are a helpful assistant. User: 'my account is locked'"
REF: "Ask for email and provide unlock steps."
```
Anya: Will add canonical refs and rerun tonight.
Samir: Blocker follow-up: Lina — if traces show kernel switch, we should try forcing cuBLAS path for one run. Can we schedule a short pairing session?
Lina: yes, 30min after lunch works. Ping me in #eng-ml.
Mike: Also pinging @Anya for comparison of eval metrics format — I want to add metric-level tags to dashboards.
Anya: happy to sync. I'll post the metric mapping in the PR.
Samir: OK. No other blockers. If anyone needs me I'll be oncall rotation so slower responses. :wave:
Lina: +1, will post traces and open an issue with perf reproduction steps.
Mike: merging adapters PR after CI green, will call out in #eng-releases.
Samir: thanks everyone :rocket:
